p: remembered Vashti: That is, he brought the matter again into discussion.
against her: By the seven wise men of his counsel.

keeper of the women: The abuse of these countries was so great, that they invented many means to serve the lusts of princes and therefore they ordained wicked laws that the king might have whose daughters he would. They had many houses appointed, one for the virgins, another for the concubines and another for the queen.
for purification be given them: Read what this purification was in Es 2:12.
every day before the court of: For though she was taken away by a cruel law, yet he did not cease to have a fatherly care for her, and therefore often sought to hear of her.
given her to go with her: Whatever apparel she asked for, the eunuch was bound to give to her.
appointed: In which her modesty appeared because she did not seek to dress to command her beauty but sought the eunuch's appointment.
month Tebeth: Which contained part of December and part of January.
feast: That is, made for her sake.
to the provinces: He released their tribute.
state of the king: That is, great and magnificent.
second time: That is, at the marriage of Esther, which was the second marriage for the king.
hand on the king Ahasuerus: Meaning, to kill him.
chronicles before the king: In the chronicles of the Medes and Persians, Es 10:2.
